# ORGON : Logistique – ID Logistics étend sa présence au Brésil et annonce la création de plus de 2 000 emplois 

Le groupe ID Logistics accélère son développement au Brésil via trois projets e-commerce qui généreront plus de 2 000 emplois sur 120 000 m².

### En images

Le groupe international de logistique contractuelle ID Logistics, basé à Orgon (Bouches-du-Rhône), a annoncé un renforcement significatif de ses activités au Brésil. En remportant trois projets d’envergure auprès de deux leaders du commerce en ligne, l’entreprise consolide sa position sur le marché sud-américain, l’un des plus stratégiques pour le secteur. Ces nouveaux contrats se traduisent par la gestion de près de 120 000 m² de surface d’entreposage et, surtout, par la création de plus de 2 000 emplois directs.

Des partenariats d’envergure pour soutenir la croissance

# SJH Fulfilment invests £3.5m in Greater Belfast expansion

 September 7, 2026 

 

SJH Fulfilment has announced a £3.5 million investment in a new 46,000 sq ft Greater Belfast fulfilment facility, more than doubling its total warehousing footprint and supporting 25 permanent jobs at the site within the next three years.

The new facility takes the company’s total warehousing footprint in Northern Ireland to 83,500 sq ft, up from 37,500 sq ft at its Kilkeel base. The additional capacity will support larger fulfilment contracts across the fashion, wellness and beauty sectors, while marking the launch of a new 10-year growth strategy targeting revenues of £50 million by 2036. Five full-time employees have already been recruited at the new site, with a further 20 permanent roles expected to be created over the next three years. An additional 10 seasonal positions will be added this winter.

## SJH Fulfilment

The company has also secured a significant contract for the site with a multi-billion-dollar US-based brand, which is consolidating its Great Britain and EU warehousing operations through Northern Ireland

# Maersk Commits US$100m to New Hopedale Fulfillment Center, Advancing Integrated Logistics Push in the US Northeast

Maersk, the global integrator of container logistics operating across more than 130 countries, is deepening its footprint in North American contract logistics with a US$100m investment in a new fulfillment center in Hopedale, Massachusetts. The 617,000-square-foot facility is scheduled to open in late August 2026, positioning the company to strengthen fulfillment capacity for cargo owners across the region.

Built around the requirements of a single major e-commerce customer, the site will function as a central node in Maersk’s contract logistics network throughout the US Northeast. During peak periods, the center is engineered to process up to 330,000 units a day, a throughput enabled by advanced conveyor and sortation systems designed for high-volume, rapid-turnaround operations.

# 'Completely transformed': Leeds business booming as Temu sales soar to £20k a day

By Abbey Maclure

Published 9th Aug 2026, 11:30 BST

## The business has quadrupled its warehouse team to cope with demand 

A Leeds business has been “completely transformed” and quadrupled its warehouse team as sales through online marketplace Temu surge to £20,000 a day.

Money Cruncher, which also trades online as Spot On-Line, has sold more than one million items through Temu since joining the platform in early 2025.

The business now dispatches more than 6,000 parcels a day from its Leeds warehouse, and the company has invested in new equipment, storage and staff to keep up with demand.

Calum McHugh (top left) alongside members of the Money Cruncher warehouse team | Money Cruncher

Spencer Saunders, Money Cruncher’s marketplace director, said the business had been “completely transformed” over the last 18 months.

“Previously we had seven full-time warehouse staff, now we have 28,” he said.

“That's 21 jobs created just operationally.”
